videos.title: Sail-Ho
videos.description: What could be more idyllic than sailing down the Croation coastline on luxurious boats, sampling exquisite Mediterranean cuisine, sunning yourself on beautiful sandy beaches and delving into the local cultural heritage? Join host Vlatka Pokos as he explores Croatia's stunning islands, secret coves, dazzling Dalmatia, sensational Dubrovnik and on to exotic Kvarner in Istria. Along the way, enjoy diving in the stunning turquoise waters or just relaxing in the beauty of the natural surroundings.

videos.title: Surfing: ISA World Adaptive Surfing Championship
videos.description: This year's anticipated 2017 ISA World Adaptive Surfing Championship will be held in sunny San Diego in the renown La Jolla neighborhood. The physically challenged surfers participate in teams of up to eight members, and represent their home countries as they race through the waters. With various events and a large following, the Championship is a fun and unique experience; both for the surfers and its spectators.

videos.title: Baltic Sea Goes Sup
videos.description: What SUP Baltic Sea?Considered a hidden gem for many years, the Baltic Sea is now a retreat for water sports practitioners. People from different parts of the world and cultures join the mesmerising background of the Baltic Sea to practice surfing, sailing and most importantly of all, SUP!Join the worldwide phenomenon of Standup Paddleboarding (SUP) that originated in Hawaii and has finally reached the Baltic Sea.Now available on Nautical Channel.

videos.title: Kite Masters
videos.description: Kite Masters is a unique monthly magazine following the hottest Kiteboarding action from around the world, introducing the latest news from this spectacular and demanding sport. This exciting, fast, extreme, and stylish sport continues to take the world my storm, and Kite Masters showcases the best events and riders. We profile the movers and shakers, different disciplines and racetrack action from the top championships and world-tour series, as well as introducing the engaging personalities and passionate athletes competing in this thrilling arena.

This exciting, fast, extreme, and stylish sport continues to take the world my storm, and Kite Masters showcases the best events and riders. We profile the movers and shakers, different disciplines and racetrack action from the top championships and world-tour series, as well as introducing the engaging personalities and passionate athletes competing in this thrilling arena.

videos.title: Salon Nautique Paris
videos.description: By the industry and the financial world as a whole it's considered one of the most important venues in the field. For the passionate French public it's an absolute must to prepare for next year's season on the water. There's just no other place like the Paris Nautic, because France is possibly the greatest boating nation on the planet. Expected in the thousands starting on Saturday December the third until the following weekend, fans will be storming the pavillions of Porte de Versailles looking for the latest innovations and the best possible deal.

When the economic crisis stroke, demand decreased, thus less boats were ordered. This forced habitants of the small island of Orust to find a new path.Refit has become the new trend in Second Life in Scandinavia. Giving a new life to beautiful yachts, not only the economy is changing, but the local community as well. The physically challenged surfers participate in teams of up to eight members, and represent their home countries as they race through the waters. With various events and a large following, the Championship is a fun and unique experience; both for the surfers and its spectators.

videos.title: Ocean Safari: Kenya
videos.description: Ocean Safari: Kenya is a thrilling documentary series following the travel adventure of host Andi van Zyl, as she visits Kenya to explore its sandy and windy beaches and challenging waters. She will meet local experts who dedicated their lives to various water activities, and try to master these skills herself in only three days. Join her in five different destinations across the country, as she discovers more about the local culture and tradition while doing her best to face the exciting and often dangerous waves of Kenyan waters.

videos.title: The Road to Bermuda
videos.description: It's a new year, so what kind of resolutions have the America's Cup athletes made? And what's the local hangover cure for too much Bermudan rum? Find out in episode 3 of Road to Bermuda! The Road to Bermuda kicks off the New Year in style. We take look at the last regatta of 2015, before celebrating the start of the New Year with the local cocktail: dark 'n' stormies. We find out what sailors do to get rid of that New Year 's Day hangover. Finally, we make sure we start the year in a good mood with the happiest man on the island, Johnny Barnes.

videos.title: The Cyclades with Andi van Zyl
videos.description: Andi van Zyl is in Ios Island at the time the Meltemi winds start, and she is ready to enjoy watersports both above and below the surface. Andi will understand the significance this island has on its habitants when she discovers what is believed to be the tomb of Homer: the creator of the Iliad and the Odyssey. This is our final stop in this journey around the Cyclades, so Andi is ready to make the most of it.
